lines.text: Maya zipped her fleece to the chin at the trailhead.
Twenty minutes up, she was soaked in sweat.
At the windy summit, that wet shirt turned ice cold.
Here's the fix. Be bold, start cold.
Begin the climb a little chilly, and take a layer off before you sweat.
Put your warm layer back on the moment you stop.
Next climb, Maya stayed dry and warm on top.
Save this before your next winter hike.
